description: This Java class 'StyleItemConverter' extends WrappingConverter and provides logic to find appropriate converters for style items based on attribute names and namespace prefixes within Android development context.

classes.name: StyleItemConverter
classes.description: A converter class for style items that determines the appropriate attribute converter based on namespace and attribute name.

methods.name: findConverterForAttribute
methods.description: Static method to find a suitable ResolvingConverter for a given attribute name and namespace prefix within the context of an AndroidFacet and DOM element.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Overrides the method to retrieve a converter for a given DOM value, based on the style item's name and namespace.
